messages:
tess: heads-up: reranker-compact-q4a canary tripped multilocale checks. BLEU -2.0, chrF -2.4, token count +3.9%. main failure modes: CJK ideograph joins/splits and Arabic ligature/bracket reordering.
marco: oof. any small repros we can share?
sora: dropped two minimal repros from the canary artifact (baseline=reranker-fp16, candidate=reranker-q4a):
```
CN INPUT: "请把最新的会议记录(第3页)发给我。"
BASELINE: "请把最新的会议记录(第3页)发给我。"
CANDIDATE: "请把最新的会议记录 \u200b(第3页)发给我。"  # zero-width space U+200B inserted before paren, breaks tokenization

JP INPUT: "昨日の会議で説明したルビ(ふりがな)を送ってください。"
BASELINE: "昨日の会議で説明したルビ(ふりがな)を送ってください。"
CANDIDATE: "昨日の会議で説明したルビ(ふりがな)を送ってください。"  # mixed zwsp + control causing token boundary shift

AR INPUT: "الوثيقة (المرفق) تحتاج توقيعاً."
BASELINE: "الوثيقة (المرفق) تحتاج توقيعاً."
CANDIDATE: "الوثيقة )المرفق( تحتاج توقيعاً."  # parentheses visually mirrored after detok
```
li: i pulled token dumps for CN/JP samples (baseline vs q4a):
```
# CN baseline ids -> tokens: [5412, 220, 9987, 44] -> tokens: ["请把", "最新的", "会议记录", "(第3页)"]
# CN candidate ids -> tokens: [5412,220,9987,77777,44] -> 77777 maps to U+200B (zero-width space)

# JP baseline ids -> tokens: [900,430,1122,33] -> tokens: ["昨日の","会議で","説明した","ルビ("]
# JP candidate ids -> tokens: [900,430,1122,88888,33] -> 88888 maps to U+200B or stray control
```
olga: infra notes: this canary used q4a pack quant (per-channel symmetric), new fused attention v4 kernels, and an experimental detok micro-opt that inlines bidi/ligature heuristics. all three rolled together.
tess: the Arabic bracket flip looks like detok bidi reordering applied after an unexpected codepoint was introduced (maybe a presentation form or directional isolate). can we bisect detok change vs kernel/quant?
marco: i'll start a commit bisect across the deploy range c7a9..d4f2 and queue a campaign: 1) force legacy detok path with q4a weights, 2) run q4a with symmetric->asymmetric switch, 3) float fallback on detok for a sub-sample.
sora: i've also added a tiny unit test to tokenizer-regress that asserts no inserted ZWSP (U+200B) or NNBSP (U+202F) around parentheses/ruby annotations for CJK samples.
platform-i18n: please tag us on the issue. we'll validate normalization and bidi isolate handling; suspicious that detok micro-opt might be stripping or inserting invisible separators.
canary-bot: canary snapshot: 1200 samples, 47 CJK zwsp/nnnbsp insertions, 9 rtl bracket/ligature diffs, delta BLEU -2.02, delta chrF -2.41. artifacts: s3://canary/reranker/3388888888/report.json
li: short-term mitigation: opt-out the detok micro-opt for reranker package in canary and re-run. add visual diffs into canary UI to highlight invisible codepoints.
marco: long-term: add char-span -> token-span diff gating in onboarding (fail if token delta > 1.5% for locale) and add bidi visual-order regression test. we'll also run q3/q5 variants to see bitwidth sensitivity.
tess: agreed. opening an issue with repro snippets, token dumps, canary link, and bisect ticket. ping me to triage live. :thumbsup:
